where.if: AND (o.code ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR o.customer_name ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR o.phone ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales_order_item si WHERE si.order_id = o.id AND si.product_name ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT o.id, o.code, o.customer_id, o.customer_name, o.phone, o.total, o.status, o.ordered_at, o.delivered_at, o.note, o.source, o.tg_chat_id, o.delivery_address, o.delivery_lat, o.delivery_lng, o.created_at, o.updated_at, (SELECT string_agg(i.product_name || ' ×' || i.qty, ', ') FROM sales_order_item i WHERE i.order_id = o.id) AS items_summary FROM sales_order o
ORDER BY o.ordered_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM sales_order GROUP BY status

SELECT id, code, customer_id, customer_name, phone, total, status, ordered_at, delivered_at, note, delivery_address, delivery_lat, delivery_lng, source, tg_chat_id, created_at, updated_at FROM sales_order WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, order_id, product_id, product_name, unit_price, qty, line_total FROM sales_order_item WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sales_order (code, customer_id, customer_name, phone, total, status, ordered_at, note, delivery_address, delivery_lat, delivery_lng, source, tg_chat_id) VALUES (#{code}, #{customerId}, #{customerName}, #{phone}, #{total}, #{status}, #{orderedAt}, #{note}, #{deliveryAddress}, #{deliveryLat}, #{deliveryLng}, #{source}, #{tgChatId})

INSERT INTO sales_order_item (order_id, product_id, product_name, unit_price, qty, line_total) VALUES
(#{it.orderId}, #{it.productId}, #{it.productName}, #{it.unitPrice}, #{it.qty}, #{it.lineTotal})
mapper.update: UPDATE sales_order SET status = #{status}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
